hero.title: Dental care is simpler when someone takes the time to explain.
hero.lead: We’re three dentists covering general care, orthodontics and implants, looking after families in Setor Bueno. You leave every visit knowing what was done, what comes next and how many sessions are left.

facts.label: At a glance
facts.landmarkValue: Two blocks from Vaca Brava Park

treatments.title: From check-ups to implants, all under one roof.
treatments.body: Every time on the site already allows for how long the visit really takes. Not sure what to choose? Book an exam: in half an hour you’ll leave with a written plan.

team.title: Three specialists, one shared chart.
team.body: When your case calls for braces or an implant, the specialist already has your history. No need to repeat everything at every visit.

approach.title: What you can expect from your very first visit.
approach.quote: “Before we touch a tooth, we show you on screen exactly what we’re seeing.”

plan.title: A written plan, no decisions in the chair
plan.body: After your exam you take home the diagnosis, the steps and an estimated number of sessions. Think it over, do your research and come back whenever you’re ready.

schedule.title: Booked for the time it really takes
schedule.body: A filling gets a full hour, a braces adjustment half that. That’s why the waiting room never fills up and your appointment starts on time.

insurance.title: Insurance checked ahead of time
insurance.body: If you have a dental plan, our front desk confirms your coverage and requests any authorizations before your visit.

sterilization.title: Sterilized, traceable instruments
sterilization.body: Every kit is sealed, labeled and opened in front of you. The autoclave log is kept at the front desk if you’d like to see it.

testimonials.title: What our patients say

featured.quote: I’d been putting off a cleaning for three years because I was scared. Dr. Helena showed me every tooth on screen before she started, and it was the first time I walked out of a dentist’s office without my shoulders up around my ears.
featured.author: Mariana S.

braces.quote: I got braces at 34. Dr. Rafael explained what would change at every adjustment, and I never waited more than ten minutes at the front desk.
braces.author: Thiago R.

implant.quote: I thought my diabetes ruled out an implant. Dr. Camila ordered tests, talked with my endocrinologist and put the plan together without rushing me.
implant.author: Sueli M.

faq.title: The questions our front desk hears most.

insurance.question: Do you take dental insurance?
insurance.answer: Yes. We accept the main dental plans in Goiânia. Enter your plan’s name when you book: our front desk confirms your coverage before the visit and lets you know if any procedure needs pre-authorization.

prices.question: Why doesn’t the site show prices?
prices.answer: Brazil’s Federal Council of Dentistry doesn’t allow clinics to advertise treatment prices. Cost also depends on your treatment plan, which you receive in writing after your exam.

booking.question: How does online booking work?
booking.answer: Choose a treatment, a dentist (or whoever is available) and an open time. Your confirmation arrives by email right away, with a link to reschedule or cancel without having to call.

reschedule.question: Can I reschedule or cancel?
reschedule.answer: Yes, using the link in your confirmation email, up to two hours before your appointment. After that, please call our front desk so we can free up the time.

children.question: Do you see children?
children.answer: Dr. Helena sees children from age six for prevention, cleanings and fillings. For babies and younger children, we’ll refer you to a pediatric dentist we trust.

pain.question: What if I’m in pain right now?
pain.answer: Book an emergency visit online: today’s open times show up straight away. If nothing is free, call our front desk and we’ll do our best to fit you in.
